question: Which of the following submarines did India gift to Myanmar?
solution:
The correct answer** is__ INS Sindhuvir.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The INS Sindhuvir, a Kilo-class submarine of the Indian Navy, has been renamed the UMS Minye Theinkhathu.**
 
• It was commissioned by the Myanmar Navy on the occasion of its 73rd anniversary. 
 
• **It is the first submarine to be acquired by the Myanmar Navy.**
 
• India has given a submarine to Myanmar as part of a military outreach to its eastern neighbor that strategic analysts say is driven by New Delhi's bid to counter China's growing influence in Southeast Asia. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36dc7aafd751ec6ad68e03e9c24a3cf2f49f50fba480f87a0f835a0ebf41bcc2.png] 

 
• **India and Myanmar share a 725-kilometer maritime boundary in the Bay of Bengal**
 
• **NS Sindhuvir is the first submarine to be given by India to another country.**
 
• The induction of the submarine was done on the 73rd anniversary of the Myanmar Navy.
 
• Ins Sindhuvir is made by the Hindustan ShipyardThe kilo class submarine has a displacement of 3000 tonnes, a diving depth of 300 meters, and a top speed of 20 knots. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Head Of Government: Prime Minister: Senior Gen. Min Aung Hlaing2**
 
• **Capital: Nay Pyi Taw (Naypyidaw)**
 
• Currency: Myanmar Kyat
 
• Population: (2021 est.) 55,199,000
